pages.title: Explosive Arrow
pages.text: §lMax Level: §r III$(br2)§lApplicable Items: §r Bow, Crossbow$(br2)§lEffect: §r Arrows explode on impact without destroying terrain. Level I: 2 block radius / 6 damage, II: 3 blocks / 9 damage, III: 4 blocks / 12 damage. The directly hit target takes full damage; nearby mobs take falloff damage. Conflicts with Chain Arrow.$(br2)§lAcquisition: §r Enchanting Table, Loot Chests, Villager Trades
